stories.title: Bank of Japan alza i tassi all'1,25%, ai massimi del 1995

en.title: Bank of Japan raises rates to 1.25%, highest since 1995
en.summary: Japan's central bank increased its benchmark interest rate to 1.25%, the highest level since 1995. The decision was approved by a 7-2 vote among board members.

stories.title: Bank of Japan alza i tassi all'1,25%, ai massimi dal 1995

en.title: Bank of Japan raises rates to 1.25%, highest since 1995
en.summary: Japan's central bank raised rates to 1.25%, addressing inflation pressures, a weak yen, and pressure from the United States.

stories.title: Jet militari russi in Lituania, i caccia italiani in volo

en.title: Russian military jets in Lithuania, Italian fighter jets in flight
en.summary: Italian fighter aircraft responded to Russian military jets near Lithuania. Prime Minister Meloni stated Putin seeks escalation with Europe while the U.S. Congress approved initial Trump-era sanctions against Russia, drawing Zelensky's approval and Kremlin condemnation.

stories.title: Crosetto: "Navi italiane a Bab el-Mandeb, senza aspettare Ue"

en.title: Crosetto: "Italian ships in Bab el-Mandeb, without waiting for EU"
en.summary: Italy's Defense Minister announced that he and the chief of staff decided not to wait for the EU mission before deploying Italian naval vessels through the Bab el-Mandeb strait.

stories.title: Jet militari russi hanno violato lo spazio aereo della Lituania, caccia italiani si alzano in volo

en.title: Russian military jets violated Lithuanian airspace, Italian fighters take off
en.summary: Russian military aircraft entered Lithuanian airspace, prompting Italian fighter jets to respond. Polish Premier Tusk has raised concerns about hybrid attacks from Moscow.

stories.title: Mar Rosso, il piano di Crosetto per scortare le navi italiane

en.title: Red Sea, Crosetto's plan to escort Italian ships
en.summary: Italy's defence minister plans to deploy a vessel for the Aspides mission to protect cargo ships in the Red Sea. Intelligence contacts with Houthi groups are underway.

stories.title: Navi italiane nel Mar Rosso, la sfida di Crosetto all'Ue: “Difendiamo solo i nostri cargo”

en.title: Italian ships in the Red Sea, Crosetto's challenge to the EU: "We defend only our cargo"
en.summary: Italian Defense Minister Crosetto is challenging the EU position on Red Sea operations while exploring potential coordination with France and Greece on the matter.

stories.title: Caccia italiani contro jet russi. Meloni: “Putin cerca l’escalation, ma non dobbiamo rispondere”

en.title: Italian fighters against Russian jets. Meloni: "Putin seeks escalation, but we must not respond"
en.summary: Italian Eurofighter jets are deployed to protect Lithuanian airspace from Russian aircraft. Italy's Prime Minister warns against escalating tensions while visiting Norway.

stories.title: Jet militari russi in Lituania, i caccia italiani in volo. Prime sanzioni di Trump a Mosca

en.title: Russian military jets in Lithuania, Italian fighters airborne. Trump's first sanctions on Moscow
en.summary: Italian fighter jets respond to Russian military aircraft incursion in Lithuania. Prime Minister Meloni cautions against retaliation and calls for unified diplomatic approach on Ukraine.

stories.title: Jet militari russi violano lo spazio aereo lituano, caccia italiani in volo. Prime sanzioni Usa contro Mosca

en.title: Russian military jets violate Lithuanian airspace, Italian fighter jets in flight. First US sanctions against Moscow
en.summary: The US House voted to impose initial sanctions on Russia ahead of elections, dealing a setback to Putin. Trump is scheduled to meet Zelensky next week at the UN General Assembly.

stories.title: Il ministro Crosetto: "Ripristinare traffico navi italiane attraverso lo stretto di Bab el-Mandeb"

en.title: Defense Minister Crosetto: "Restore Italian ship traffic through the Strait of Bab el-Mandeb"
en.summary: The defense minister announced plans to resume Italian maritime circulation through the Strait of Bab el-Mandeb, comparing the significance of this move to reopening the Strait of Hormuz.

stories.title: Piove negli Uffizi, bagnata la teca del Bacco di Caravaggio

en.title: It rains in the Uffizi, the case of Caravaggio's Bacchus gets wet
en.summary: A water leak occurred in the Uffizi Gallery during a rainstorm, damaging the display case containing Caravaggio's Bacchus painting.

stories.title: Vino: primo positivo rimbalzo dell’export italiano negli Stati Uniti

en.title: Wine: first significant rebound in Italian export sales to the United States
en.summary: Italian wine exports to the United States experienced their first significant rebound in July, according to European Commission data analyzed by the Italian Wine Union Observatory.

stories.title: Sea investe 600 milioni per la crescita di Malpensa

en.title: Sea invests 600 million for Malpensa growth
en.summary: Sea is investing 600 million euros in Malpensa airport's expansion, with major projects including the enlargement of Terminal 1 toward the north.

stories.title: «In Bocconi 200 milioni per investire in giovani e ricerca»

en.title: Bocconi receives 200 million to invest in youth and research
en.summary: Bocconi University has received 200 million euros in funding to support investments in young people and research activities.

stories.title: Pubblicità digitale, Rai e Mediaset ai big del web: serve trasparenza

en.title: Digital advertising, Rai and Mediaset call on tech giants: transparency needed
en.summary: Rai and Mediaset are demanding greater transparency from major tech companies in the digital advertising market, which is valued at around one billion euros, questioning claims about its precision and efficiency.

stories.title: Napoli, un piano industriale per attrarre investimenti ad alto impatto

en.title: Naples, an industrial plan to attract high-impact investments
en.summary: Naples requires a multi-year industrial strategy focused on attracting manufacturing investments to southern Italy and retaining young talent in the region.
